title: Class-II gauge-horizontal source, translation model, universal Q, and obstruction boundary
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A13 strict sharp cubes, exact Class-II algebra and independently executed fixtures close several invalid proof architectures without closing the Nelson theorem. v1.1 fixes the factor-four allocation, proves exact equivalence of the one-use target to the open q=10/9 Nelson moment, and refutes endpoint-only timewise Young and the direct one-shot Ramer map. The translation continuation proves the flexible epsilon_6<gamma/6 field range, exact finite-cutoff translation/frame and Cartan identities, deterministic-shift expectation positivity, and the deterministic-constant remainder no-go. A13-CLASSII-UNIVERSAL-Q-ALL-MOMENTS-AND-CM-TRANSLATION is now closed: the universal centered derivative-square tensor converges in every finite Lp(Omega;H^(-1-kappa)) and has a locally Lipschitz deterministic H2 Cameron-Martin action. Adversarial analysis also proves that literal full XQ/XXQ products miss the advertised L2 model regularities. A cone-localized subdiagram of a raw nested resonant QXX tree has a fixed negative scalar coefficient whose magnitude accumulates logarithmically, but noncancellation of the total symmetric tree is not proved. The parent translated-current model lift and umbrella one-use theorem remain open; A13-CLASSII-COEFFICIENT-JET-RENORMALISATION-CLASSIFICATION is selected next.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-TRANSLATION-AND-UNIVERSAL-Q-REDUCTIONS-WITH-EXECUTED-NOGOS@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production symbol and coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, exact Fourier products, common real-even finite sharp regulators, exact A7 covariance subtraction, and the A10-A13 dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The Fierz, Gaussian, Hardy, flexible potential, exact translation/frame, deterministic expectation, Cartan, universal-Q Fourier-Wick, all-finite-moment, deterministic H2 translation, one-use/Nelson equivalence, nonfrozen Schatten-two, coefficient-curl, conditional determinant, full-product L2 regularity no-go, and cone-localized nested-resonance magnitude lower bound are analytic. Finite convolution, Hermite, cone, carrier, Ramer, and manufactured-grid fixtures are independently reproduced regression evidence rather than continuum proofs. Total-tree angular noncancellation, adapted random translation control, coefficient-jet renormalisation/reconstruction, the parent model lift, and umbrella one-use gate remain open.
falsifier: A failure of any prior A13 Fierz, source, factor-four, one-use/Nelson, scalar-loop, nonfrozen determinant, potential, translation/frame, Cartan, expectation, or deterministic-remainder assertion remains a falsifier. For the universal-Q continuation, failure of the <k>^-2 convolution bound, H^(-1-kappa) summability, all-finite-p hypercontractive lift, mixed H2 Cameron-Martin Fourier estimate, exact translation identity, full-product low-high lower bound, fixed negative cone-localized coefficient and positive magnitude lower bound, nonzero localized first-chaos witness, either independent implementation, source hashes, six-page PDF QA, 110-assertion aggregate, or release gate falsifies the package.

reproduction.expected: Primary 42/42, non-importing independent 22/22, and integrated aggregate 110/110 pass; A13-CLASSII-UNIVERSAL-Q-CM-TRANSLATION-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.

no_overclaim: This claim proves all finite probability moments only for the universal centered Q tensor and its deterministic H2 translation, not for the nonlinear rational coefficient reconstruction. It does not construct renormalised QX/QXX coefficient correctors, prove total-tree noncancellation or cancellation of lower-chaos terms, exclude a surviving interaction counterterm, control random or adapted translations, prove the signed form bound, controlled-shell estimate, equivalent q=10/9 Nelson moment, A11/A7 closure, full log-Laplace bound, interacting measure, floor or regulator removal, infinite volume, phase transition, BCC selection, T5, T6, or T7. The cone-localized logarithmic magnitude certificate requires classification; it does not by itself refute every unnormalised symmetric tree, every corrected model, or the Nelson theorem.
next_action: Prove A13-CLASSII-COEFFICIENT-JET-RENORMALISATION-CLASSIFICATION under the still-open A13-CLASSII-CAMERON-MARTIN-TRANSLATED-CURRENT-MODEL-LIFT. Fix base-point increment symbols or an exact balanced corrector family; enumerate all first-, second-, and zero-chaos contractions for both two-X/one-Q parenthesisations; prove coupled-cutoff all-finite-p convergence; and reconstruct Delta B:Q plus the translated current in the exact A7 scheme. The logarithmic and finite lower-chaos terms must be proved to cancel or a surviving interaction counterterm must be registered. Only then attempt the strict-past signed Q/current/positive-square/Cartan-curvature form bound. Previously excluded termwise Young, circular variational recastings, repeated past-energy payment, and one-shot Ramer routes remain forbidden.
notes: Scoped T4 exact reductions plus executed architecture no-gos. The universal-Q continuation closes Q in every finite Lp(H^(-1-kappa)) and deterministic H2 Cameron-Martin continuity, while correcting the ambiguous coefficient-jet statement: full products miss the L2 target and a cone-localized raw nested subdiagram has a fixed negative coefficient with logarithmically accumulating magnitude. Total-tree noncancellation is not claimed. Primary 42/42, non-importing independent 22/22, and integrated 110/110 are the current continuation evidence. Earlier A13 packages remain binding for their scopes. T-050 remains in progress at the umbrella one-use gate; coefficient-jet renormalisation classification is selected next. Tier stays T4.
